about.title: About Shield Roofing Systems
text: Shield Roofing Systems is a veteran-owned and operated business in Pearland and Houston that was founded by Joshua Veach and Kyle Hough. We set out to prove that an honest, hardworking, and service-driven roofing company could not only survive but flourish in an industry that often falls short of expectations. Our mission is to build trust with our clients through transparency, open communication, and a commitment to excellence.

At Shield Roofing Systems, we prioritize transparency in our service. We understand the frustration that can come with feeling taken advantage of in the roofing industry, which is why we have implemented self-service estimating tools and low pressure sales to give our customers ownership over the decisions they make for their properties. We believe in empowering our clients with knowledge and options, eliminating the need for door knocking and aggressive sales tactics.
We’re proud of the work we do in our community and are excited to be able to offer top-tier service and professional expertise as evidenced by our variety of memberships and accreditations.
